_README.description: Zhipu GLM via the Z.ai OpenAI-compatible API (native provider, ZAI_API_KEY).
_README.usage: Base URL https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4. GLM-5.3 is API-only (open weights delayed), so this direct route is the way to reach the latest GLM. Scores pinned to the z-ai/* OpenRouter mirrors. Verify model IDs against /models if a call 404s.

models.description: Zhipu GLM-5.3 - flagship reasoning/coding MoE (API-only; open weights staged). Direct Z.ai API. Score at the high-effort anchor is interpolated: AA has no high row (low 34, max 45), so high is taken as about 40.
Zhipu GLM-5.3 Flash - native multimodal MoE (320B/18B, 1M context, AA Intelligence Index 42). Flash sibling of GLM-5.3, direct Z.ai API.
Zhipu GLM-4.6 - prior flagship. Direct Z.ai API.
